Q8495.reason: The corona is extremely hot but very tenuous, so its surface brightness is far too low to see against the photosphere except when the Moon blocks the disk.

Q8500.reason: The Pleistocene began about 2.6 million years ago with the onset of repeated glacial climates, so the planet grew colder and entered that epoch.

Q8502.reason: Leaving artifacts in situ preserves provenience so excavators can record their spatial contexts and associations before removal.
